text: {"findings":[{"resource_address":"azurerm_role_assignment.operations","doc_id":"POL-003","attribute":"role_definition_name","title":"azurerm_role_assignment.operations grants \"Owner\" at management group scope \"/providers/Microsoft.Management/managementGroups/mg-platform\", which is wider than a subscription and can delegate broad access.","suggestion":"Assign a narrower role, or move this assignment to a resource group or specific resource scope instead of the management group.","breaks_standard":true}]}
